_readme: floor_pct: the barrier FAILS if a platform's live coverage drops below this.
A platform ABSENT from this file fails the barrier outright: onboarding a platform now
REQUIRES declaring its expected image coverage here (or imageless_at_source with a reason).
Raise floors when a fix lands; never lower one to clear a red — a drop is an incident.

rebased.why: Scraping Engineer 2026-10-07: the 55 floor came from the FIRST 100 index rows (62%), not the catalogue. The office posts about half its cards with only its shared «logos.png» placeholder (515 of 987 index rows, scrapers/alshawaf/run.py PLACEHOLDER_IMG), which the scraper refuses. A CI re-read of 8 cards matches our capture exactly: every page with an og:image is a card we hold a photo for (5/5), every page without one is a card we hold none for (3/3). So 47.9% is the source's own coverage, not a capture loss. Floor = today minus a ~4-point margin.
